gripOrHq.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Urban Renewal
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Vapor Ops
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Employee Empowerment
scoreArea.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

rig.title: “Green Knight” Surge Buffers
rig.rulesText: Prevents up to 1 Net damage each turn.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Microtech Backup Drive
rig.rulesText:
Whenever one or more installed programs are being sent to the trash at the same time, you may instead choose to put any or all of the programs on top of Microtech Backup Drive in any order you choose. If Backup Drive is removed from play, trash any cards on it.
A: Bring the top card on Backup Drive into your hand.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

ice.title: Canis Major
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.

Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.
